title: Shukra (Venus) ka ek din uske ek saal se lamba!
source: NASA Space Place · Snopes · National Geographic Kids

captions.instagram:
On Venus, your birthday comes before the planet finishes one spin!

Venus par aapka birthday, uske ek chakkar se pehle hi aa jaata hai 🪐

Ek chakkar = 243 din, Suraj ka chakkar = 225 din. Aur wahan Suraj PASCHIM se ugta hai! Twist: sunrise se sunrise tak ~117 din, yaani ek saal mein sirf ~2 sunrise.

Sources: NASA Space Place, Snopes, National Geographic Kids.
Photo: NASA Mariner 10 (Public domain).

Verses:
• Venus takes 243 Earth days to spin once — NASA Space Place
• Venus takes 225 Earth days to orbit the Sun (one Venus year) — NASA Space Place
• Venus spins the opposite way to Earth and most planets, so the Sun would rise in the west — NASA Space Place; National Geographic Kids
• Sunrise to sunrise (the solar day) on Venus is about 117 Earth days — Snopes (fact check)
• So in one Venus year (225 days) the Sun rises only about twice (225 / ~117 ≈ 1.9) — Arithmetic from NASA Space Place (225 days) and Snopes (~117-day solar day)
